summary: Following the host's preparation of a V from the page, until its record is ready.
work: Asks the host to prepare a character request and follows the run by key until a record key, a failure or a need arrives.
cancel: The page's token ends its interest; the host is asked to cancel the preparation, and only this requester's share of the run ends.

faults.when: The host reports it needs WolvenKit.

x-friction.gap: The work runs on the host; the page follows it by polling with backoff and re-asks if the host restarted.
x-friction.closes: Work in another process mirrored here as a process, resumed after restarts and cancelled by asking.
